description:
Advances: ancora.gate, ancora.tasks

Stage: L9 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Gate (spec.check orchestration over the seven-stage pipeline: preflight, corpus, change set, derivation, compare, findings, output), Ancora.Gate.Preflight (git repo present; base resolvable; umbrella via ProjectInfo; no .app or dev-build check exists), mix spec.check (flags --base, --verbose, --debug, --root, --spec-dir, --json; full report map via Jason with the verdict line still last), mix spec.validate (--strict, --debug, --root, --spec-dir). Missing-base hard-fail message names git fetch origin main, --base <ref>, and default_base. All task error paths route through Output.gated. Mix bootstrap posture: tasks require deps.loadpaths and never compile the target project; cold-checkout first-run behavior documented in the task moduledoc. Ancora.Json utility. Diff-scoping integration: acknowledgment clears drift/growth/shrink; Spec-Ack trailer downgrades; brand-new subject self-clears; change/uncovered_file and change/missing_decision wired; strict verdict semantics.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.gate.preflight_hard_fails, default_base_no_fallback, diff_scoped_versus_repo_state, acknowledgment_clears, new_subject_self_clears, unanchored_subject, change_findings, strict_verdict, no_derived_state; ancora.tasks.gated_emission_paths, check_flags, validate_flags, exit_codes, mix_bootstrap_posture; ancora.findings.info_visibility
- Behaviors to demonstrate: the five subprocess goldens via System.cmd("mix", ...) in warmed fixture projects with stdout and stderr captured separately: ancora.tasks.scenario.green_golden, findings_golden, env_golden, usage_golden, internal_raise_has_no_verdict (asserts the verdict line is ABSENT), plus json_golden, config_diagnostic_on_stderr, no_validate_status_line, validate_rejects_output, no_project_compile; ancora.gate.scenario.missing_base_hard_fails, base_head_is_legal, not_a_git_repo, drift_cleared_by_spec_edit, trailer_downgrades_not_silences, new_subject_clears_itself, unanchored_every_run, override_silences_one_subject, uncovered_lib_file, governance_change_without_adr, warning_fails_check_not_validate, empty_corpus_is_green, no_output_flag_on_gate_tasks; ancora.findings.scenario.info_hidden_by_default
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.check --base HEAD once the task runs; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only; the subprocess goldens are in scope for the verifier
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: consumer CI (shared workflow, post-shim) and the agent loop call mix spec.check; the replay harness (M1) calls --json; proving tests are the goldens here
  - Fixture hygiene: fixture projects under test/fixtures/projects are warmed once per suite, never committed with _build; git repos for diff cases built at runtime
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each preflight check, each gated branch, each flag rejection)
- Call-site Integration: production callers are consumer CI and the agent loop; proving tests are the subprocess goldens, which exercise the contract exactly as those callers consume it. --json production caller is the replay harness (M1); proving test is the JSON golden here plus the harness self-test.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/{prime,next,status,review}*, lib/mix/tasks/spec.{prime,next,status,review,init,decision.new}.ex (L10-L12)
- lib/ancora/derive/** (read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/gate.ex, lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex, lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex, lib/ancora/json.ex, lib/ancora.ex (validate/3 facade)
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex
- test/ancora/gate*_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_{check,validate}_test.exs, test/ancora/golden/**, test/fixtures/projects/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no base fallback ladder; no .app precondition; no --output on check/validate
- no retired flags accepted (--no-run-commands, --min-strength, --command-timeout-ms, --accept-drift, --test-tags, --run-commands)
- no project compilation triggered by any task
- when widening a shared helper, check every caller (retro class 2)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base HEAD runs in this repo and emits a verdict line (smoke; subjects still draft)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

Reasoning

I traced every blocking finding from both graders in the code; all confirm. The verifier did not err, so this routes to the implementer.

The production defect is real and I confirmed it by trace alone. Config.t cannot represent an absent lib_paths key (defstruct default at lib/ancora/config.ex:56 and the parse default at :189 both produce ["lib"]). Preflight.run passes config.lib_paths into ProjectInfo.load unconditionally (lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex:25,66). ProjectInfo.load short-circuits to the passed option whenever :lib_paths is in opts (lib/ancora/project_info.ex:105-106) and never reaches literal_elixirc_paths/1. A target with literal elixirc_paths: ["lib", "extra"] and no configured lib_paths resolves to ["lib"] on the gate path, so modules under non-lib paths vanish from membership with no diagnostic. Notably ProjectInfo's own no-opts path is correct (configured_lib_paths/1 checks Map.has_key? at project_info.ex:139-149); only Preflight's threading breaks the contract.

Spec ruling: the appended gate-spec sentence ("Preflight shall load .spec/config.yml once and thread the resulting config through project identity and gate assembly") is part of the defect. Given Config's current type, threading "the resulting config" into project identity makes it impossible to honor the unedited ancora.derive.project_info_from_root must ("elixirc_paths: read as literals ... A dynamic elixirc_paths shall degrade to [lib], overridable by the lib_paths: config key") without re-reading the yaml, which the sentence forbids. lib/ancora/derive/** and its spec are read-only for this ticket; a co-change may acknowledge, never weaken, and this edit canonizes contradicting behavior. The single-load property itself is worth keeping, so the fix is textual amendment, not deletion of the idea. The tasks-spec sentence is a genuine acknowledgment and is fine.

Coverage gaps: all five verifier scenario gaps are ticket-listed under "Behaviors to demonstrate" and I confirmed each scenario block's text in .spec/specs (gate spec :225-273, tasks spec :259-268) against the committed tests. json_golden explicitly requires a growth finding in the parsed JSON; the committed test runs on an empty corpus (subjects=0, result=pass). override_silences_one_subject requires two subjects A and B with B staying warning; the committed test has one. unanchored_every_run requires run-twice plus the overrides: mention. governance_change_without_adr has no gate test at all. warning_fails_check has no committed check-side test. All material.

Test critic items also confirmed: @switches in spec.check.ex:17 and spec.validate.ex:15 are clean, but only --no-run-commands and --output have rejection tests, against the ticket's standing check "each flag rejection"; no test anywhere feeds Ancora.validate an error-severity finding, so the fail? computation at lib/ancora.ex:51 is mutable with a green suite; the no-compile golden (spec_check_test.exs:114-124) asserts status != 0 and a stderr refute but never the verdict line, so a crash is indistinguishable from a completed run.

Standard checks: 12 files touched, all inside Allowed globs, zero in Out of Scope; L10-L12 files and lib/ancora/derive/** untouched. Intent greps clean: no retired flag anywhere in lib/, no .app or _build inspection in preflight or project_info, no --output switch, single merge-base clause with no fallback ladder, both tasks @requirements ["deps.loadpaths"] with no compile trigger. Seams: no test/fixtures/projects exists; fixtures are runtime tmp git repos and the warmed project is the checkout itself. Deviation from the fixture-layout letter, but the goldens run the real mix tasks as subprocesses against those roots, so the production call path (spec.check -> Output.gated -> Ancora.check -> Gate) is exercised end to end. No disconnected production path; no INTEGRATION_REGRESSION_LATENT.

Bounce reason (consolidated; one respawn clears all)

1. PRODUCTION FIX: Preflight discards literal elixirc_paths. Make Config distinguish an absent lib_paths key (nil default in the struct and parser instead of ["lib"]; resolve the ["lib"] fallback at the consumer or keep it where a key is present but empty-invalid). Preflight then passes lib_paths: to ProjectInfo.load only when configured (non-nil), letting the literal elixirc_paths read run otherwise. Keep the single-YAML-parse property. Add a regression test: target with literal elixirc_paths ["lib", "extra"] and no config key resolves both paths through Preflight.run, and a configured lib_paths still overrides.
2. SPEC TEXT: amend the sentence appended to ancora.gate.preflight_hard_fails so it no longer contradicts ancora.derive.project_info_from_root, e.g. "...thread the resulting config through project identity and gate assembly; the config lib_paths: key overrides project identity only when present in .spec/config.yml, and literal elixirc_paths: is honored otherwise." If not amended, revert the appended sentence entirely (block ends at "No preflight check shall inspect _build or any .app file.").
3. TEST: gate test for ancora.gate.scenario.governance_change_without_adr — .spec/config.yml changed in the diff, no .spec/decisions/ change, change/missing_decision fires through Gate.check.
4. TEST: ancora.gate.scenario.override_silences_one_subject as specified — two unanchored subjects, override on A only; assert A info, B warning.
5. TEST: ancora.tasks.scenario.json_golden with a real finding — fixture producing a growth finding; assert the finding appears in the parsed JSON report and the verdict line stays last.
6. TEST: ancora.gate.scenario.warning_fails_check_not_validate check side — committed test where a warning-only corpus makes mix spec.check exit non-zero with result=fail (the existing accidental coverage in the stderr test does not count and is fragile).
7. TEST: ancora.gate.scenario.unanchored_every_run — run the gate twice on an unchanged tree, derived/unanchored_subject fires both times, message mentions the overrides: construct.
8. TEST: retired-flag rejection for the full set — loop --min-strength, --command-timeout-ms, --accept-drift, --test-tags, --no-run-commands on spec.check and --run-commands, --output on spec.validate; each exits 1 with a last-line usage verdict.
9. TEST: validate with an error-severity finding — fixture corpus containing an error (e.g. broken tagged-test file or invalid spec meta); assert exit 1 and result=fail without --strict, killing the fail? mutation at lib/ancora.ex:51.
10. TEST: no_project_compile golden asserts the verdict line, e.g. List.last(lines(result.stdout)) =~ "spec.check result=fail tier=", so a crash cannot pass as a completed run.

Worth carrying from the critic's advisories while in there (non-blocking): drop the check_flags/validate_flags tags from the vacuous "callable surfaces are present" test, and item 5 makes the bolted-on Ancora.Json.encode! assert at spec_check_test.exs:77 movable to a unit test.
